method: Built-in image generation and reference editing
background_arrival: Production asset edit. Use supplied approved Ninth Tide office illustration. Create CLEAN ROOM BACKGROUND PLATE by removing ONLY the brass desk lamp including base, arms and shade, and the tiny metal parts tray on the desktop immediately right of lamp. Reconstruct underlying plain wall/wainscoting and thin desktop edge seamlessly. Keep ALL other pixels and design as close as possible: exact straight-on geometry, desk, chair, book, upright documents, mug, map, window, sea, coat, door, stove and framing. No new objects, no new text. Add ONE additional brass hook at left end of rail so nine hooks in total; keep coat where it is. Keep calm overcast early-game weather. Preserve flat ink and matte paper illustration, no perspective, no angled desktop plane. This is full scene production background for layering separate movable lamp and tray sprites, NOT a new composition. Same 4:3 aspect and resolution as input.
background_rain: Edit supplied clean Ninth Tide Intake Office background plate into intermediate Tide III weather state. Preserve exact flat frontal composition, positions, framing, 4:3 dimensions, linework and paper texture. Keep empty left desktop space: do not add a lamp or parts tray. Nine hooks. All furniture and props exactly same. Change ONLY weather and environmental color: grey sky darker and lower than source, moderate thin rain streaks on window, slightly rougher sea with flat pale wave lines, same lighthouse and jetty clearly recognizable but faded by mist. Cool wall subtly towards grey-green, a little damp staining directly below sill. Coat still ordinary and unoccupied, NO human-shaped shadow yet. Small existing puddle unchanged. This is a middle state, less dark than a violent storm, all objects readable. No angled perspective, no cinematic lighting, no UI, no text, no new props.
background_ominous: Edit this exact clean production background plate into Tide VI ominous weather state. Keep all geometry and object positions EXACTLY fixed, identical framing and dimensions, flat frontal elevation, fine ink lines and matte subtle paper texture. Do NOT add a desk lamp or parts tray: empty desk space on left must remain empty for separately layered sprites. Outside window, turn sky charcoal indigo with low clouds, sea dark blue with sparse pale waves, heavy rain on panes, same jetty and lighthouse still faintly discernible through rain. Cool interior wall to grey sage with damp patches below window and lower wainscoting. Keep paper, book, mug, handles and map clearly readable, no heavy vignette. Add subtly human head-and-shoulders shadow on wall to right of hanging coat, shadow only with no eyes or person. Coat remains unchanged. Puddle slightly larger with few flat ripples. Nine hooks exactly as source. No changes to room layout, door, desk, proportions or style. No angled perspective, cinematic shading, blur, glowing effects, new furniture or UI. Full 4:3 background matching source for crossfade between states.
lamp: Generate a game sprite on genuinely transparent alpha background, no checkerboard baked in. Reference image shows approved art style and the exact lamp design to extract/redraw. SINGLE isolated brass desk lamp ONLY, no room or other items. Match the source lamp: stepped round low base, thin upright brass stem with circular elbow near base, upper elbow, short articulated arm leaning to right, round downward-facing dome shade at upper right. Flat orthographic front elevation, elegant dark navy ink outlines, muted ochre brass, matte subtle paper texture, no perspective or 3D realistic light. Whole lamp fully visible with generous transparent margins, in tall 2:3 portrait canvas, base centered low. Lamp UNLIT: underside of shade muted dark ochre, no glow and no cast shadow outside lamp silhouette. Lamp should occupy about 70% width and 80% height. All free spaces between stem/arms/base transparent, including outside silhouette. Finely hand drawn with clear shapes at game scale. No wire, lettering, UI or other props. This is the separate movable lamp sprite for the office, preserve design identity.
note: Lamp cleanup attempts produced RGB checkerboards and were excluded. Original lamp has real alpha; RGB halo outside silhouette is transparent. SVG/PNG precision parts authored by tools/build_vectors.py. Backgrounds are full state plates, not pixel-identical layer separations.
